answer: Work-slot deposit burning: each agent buys one work slot by burning a 40-credit deposit, valid one epoch from dawn. The ridge is the bar: only agents that complete verified work keep the slot; idle or duplicate slots burn their deposit. A tide of fakes needs 100 slots, burning 4,000 credits against a 5,000-credit pool, while an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its slot and full share. Burning makes bulk identity costly to repeat.
